blogs.title: Revealing the Hidden Reward: How Language Models Are Secretly Learning What Humans Want
blogs.description: An accessible walkthrough of the key insight behind Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) – that a language model’s probability distribution can act as its own reward function. The post explains how DPO flips the traditional RLHF pipeline and why this changes what we mean by “reward” when training AI.

blogs.title: From Two-Choice Clicks to a One‑Step Fine‑Tuning: Demystifying Direct Preference Optimization
blogs.description: A step‑by‑step guide that takes readers through the DPO algorithm: generating preference pairs, the Bradley‑Terry model, the clever change‑of‑variables trick, and the simple cross‑entropy objective. Great for readers who want to see the math in plain language.

blogs.title: Why DPO Beats PPO: The Real‑World Benefits of RL‑Free Fine‑Tuning
blogs.description: A comparison of DPO with classic PPO‑based RLHF across sentiment control, summarization, and dialogue tasks. Highlights the efficiency, stability, and lower compute cost, making it easier for developers to train aligned models.

blogs.title: Scaling Up Alignment: What DPO Means for Future Generative AI
blogs.description: Explores the implications of DPO for large‑scale language models, potential extensions to other modalities, and practical questions around generalisation, hyper‑parameter tuning, and automated evaluation with GPT‑4.
